notes:
Discover became a real Apple Music client.

FIND MUSIC, THEN PLAY IT IN ANY ROOM. Discover is now a list of services rather than a bare search box. Tap Apple Music and you are into Apple's whole catalogue - artists, albums, songs and playlists - laid out the way the Library is, in sections you can scroll with a See all on each. Tidal and Qobuz are listed but greyed out, because that is where this is going next.

ARTIST PAGES. Tap an artist and you get their photo across the top, then their albums, singles and EPs, compilations, top songs, the records they appear on, playlists, and artists like them. Tap one of those and you are on THEIR page, so you can keep wandering outward. Everything Apple keeps separate stays separate - a compilation someone merely plays on no longer sits in the middle of their own records.

PLAYLISTS PLAY, AND THAT HAD NEVER BEEN TRIED. Sorriva could already hand Sonos a song or an album. A playlist was written down as possible and had never actually been built and played. It works - a 21-track and a 50-track Apple playlist both played on a speaker that had never been given them.

PRESS AND HOLD ANYTHING TO PLAY IT SOMEWHERE. A long press on an album, song, playlist or artist asks which room, the same everywhere.

IT KEEPS YOUR PLACE. Leave Discover for another tab and come back, and your search, your results and how far you had wandered are all still there.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED TO LOOK AROUND. Searching Apple's catalogue asks permission once and never again, and needs no Apple Music subscription at all. Playing is what needs the subscription - and it is your Sonos system's, set up once in the Sonos app, never anything Sorriva holds.

NOT IN THIS RELEASE. Nothing you find is saved yet - close the app and there is no record of it. Saving Apple Music into your library alongside your own FLAC is the next substantial piece of work and it needs the library rebuilt underneath first. Shuffle and repeat still live on Now Playing only. Artist biographies are not appearing and that is being looked at.
